            --include-package=pytest \
            --include-package=coverage \
            --include-package=flake8 \
            --include-package=pylint \
            --include-package=mypy \
            --include-package=black \
            --include-package=isort \
            --include-package=autopep8 \
            --include-package=yapf \
            --include-package=pycodestyle \
            --include-package=pydocstyle \
            --include-package=pyflakes \
            --include-package=bandit \
            --include-package=safety \
            --include-package=licensecheck \
            --include-package=pyupdater \
            --include-package=pyinstaller \
            --include-package=cx_Freeze \
            --include-package=py2exe \
            --include-package=py2app \
            --include-package=nuitka \
            dirsearch.py

      - name: Handle Nuitka output name differences
        run: |
          # Nuitka may produce different output filenames depending on version and platform
          # Check for common variations and standardize to 'dirsearch'
          if [ -f "dist/dirsearch.bin" ]; then
            mv dist/dirsearch.bin dist/dirsearch
          elif [ -f "dist/dirsearch.exe" ]; then
            mv dist/dirsearch.exe dist/dirsearch
          elif [ -f "dist/dirsearch" ]; then
            echo "Output file already named correctly"
          else
            echo "Warning: Could not find expected output file in dist/"
            ls -la dist/
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Make executable
          chmod +x dist/dirsearch
          
          # Verify the binary works
          dist/dirsearch --version || true

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-linux-py${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: dist/dirsearch
          retention-days: 30
